reading_note: The teaching describes how the divine human form (the First Image — the form of love and wisdom) shapes the two great receptacles in the heavens: the celestial sun (love) and the spiritual moon (truth). It then unfolds the seven goods that divine truth-as-light works upon the natural mind when it shines: (1) illumination of understanding, (2) tranquillity from fear, (3) awakening from spiritual sleep, (4) nourishment of every perception, knowledge and work, (5) withdrawal of evil affections into their interior hiding-places, (6) dissolution of falsities from evil and magical persuasions, (7) manifestation of the heavens' sign in ultimates. The arc then pivots to the contrary: the seven evils that night (the state of falsity) works when love and truth withdraw — beginning with the universal darkening of the natural mind. The single arc: the descent of the divine form into receptive vessels, its sevenfold operation as light upon every degree of the natural mind, and the inverse sevenfold operation of falsity when that light is withdrawn.
